feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed. The best raced design is iteration 3 (893.56): sensors at +/-3 cm, kp 2.25, kd 0.9, base_speed 1.2. It finishes the oval 20/20 and the s-bend 20/20. On the slalom it finishes 15/20, all 5 failures are off-track, slalom steering_oscillation is 0.25 and rms_error is 0.012 m, so the loop is stable and the loss is drift on the sharpest bends. Iteration 4 showed speed is not the cause: base_speed 1.1 gave 879.5 with a worse slalom (13/20). Iteration 5 showed that widening the spread to +/-4 cm with kp 3.0 and kd 1.2 gave 887.7, with 14/20 slalom finishes, 6 off-track, and higher control effort (8.0). So the spread change did not help, and that iteration does not separate the effect of kd from the spread and kp changes.

The candidate is valid and is a clean single-variable change from iteration 3: kd 0.9 to 1.2, with geometry, kp 2.25, ki 0 and base_speed 1.2 unchanged. That makes the race a direct test of whether more derivative damping cuts slalom overshoot. The main risk is that kd 1.2 at kp 2.25 raises jitter on the oval and s-bend, which are currently near their limits. Read the race this way. If slalom off-track ends fall and steering_oscillation stays at or below about 0.3, keep kd 1.2 and consider a small kp adjustment. If slalom off-track ends persist with low line_loss_events and high max_error, the failures are overshoot from kp, so test kp 2.0 next. If line_loss_events rise on any track, the 16 mm footprint at 3 cm is the limit, so test 12 mm sensors next. Check completion, completion_time, progress, line_loss_events, max_error, steering_oscillation, control_effort and noise_robustness per track to separate line loss from overshoot.
requested_changes: If slalom off-track ends persist with line_loss_events at or below 0.25 and steering_oscillation at or below 0.3: lower controller.kp from 2.25 to 2.0 with kd 1.2 held, since iteration 5 showed the slalom still drifting at higher kp (3.0) and iteration 3 showed low oscillation (0.25).

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 on the oval or s-bend: return controller.kd toward 1.0 with kp 2.25, since iteration 3 oscillation was 0.21 to 0.28 at kd 0.9 and iteration 5 was 0.28 to 0.30 at kd 1.2.

If line_loss_events rise above 0.5 on the slalom: change geometry.sensor_size from 0.016 to 0.012, keeping the iteration 3 spread, since the wider spread in iteration 5 did not reduce line loss (0.3 per run) and the 16 mm footprint may be the limit.
